verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents a first-party Batches API that scrapes up to 25K URLs or crawls large sites asynchronously, with progress tracking and retrieval of results when the job finishes, so it directly delivers bulk operations across many items. All of this evidence is vendor documentation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of batch behavior at scale, documented bulk support for non-scrape endpoints (e.g. brand or people lookups), per-item batch error handling details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Scrape 25K URLs or crawl large websites asynchronously.
Crawl up to 25,000 pages in a background batch, track progress, and retrieve Markdown or HTML when the job finishes.
Crawl a small website section and return page Markdown in one response, with a maximum of 500 pages.
